title: Concept: Legacy keyed unarchiving in swift — review required
description: In swift, unarchiveTopLevelObjectWithData rebuilds an object graph from bytes. The archive names its own classes, so a crafted payload selects what the process instantiates and which decoding initialisers run. The newer API offers requiringSecureCoding; this legacy call does not, which is why it remains a deserialization sink.
applicability: swift apps that decode keyed archives from files, messages, or the network.
risk: Object injection leading to code execution; HIGH severity.
